scope: Root bounded B05v3 one-item correction; independent semantic acceptance pending

oldWrongOption.text: Introduce a versioned payout message and route older workers through a compatibility adapter.

newWrongOption.text: Renumber the existing settlement fields onto unused tags and send that payload directly to unchanged workers.

oldWrongDiagnosis.text: A versioned message could route old workers, but the scenario already permits a fresh additive tag and compatible absent value; the extra message type does not solve a stated incompatibility.

newWrongDiagnosis.text: Older workers still read the original settlement tags. Moving those values to unused tags leaves their expected fields absent; a new message version cannot supply the missing values without translation.

wrongOptionIdentityReason: The former adapter design could preserve compatibility; current design changes existing wire identities without translation, a different misconception requiring a different ID.

primarySource.verifiedClaim: Field numbers identify fields on the wire; changing existing numbers is wire-unsafe. A differently named message alone does not establish incompatibility.
